connections.edgeLabel: AAWSAP contract performed from Las Vegas
connections.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
connections.note: AAWSAP was performed by BAASS out of Robert Bigelow's Nevada base rather than from Washington, which is what puts this programme on a map of southern Nevada at all. Two limits keep it at tier 2. The federal award system places BIGELOW AEROSPACE LLC at North Las Vegas - a separate municipality from Las Vegas - on NASA contracts, not on the DIA contract; and searches of USASpending for 'Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies' and for 'BAASS' both return nothing, so the AAWSAP contract is not in the public award record under either name.

connections.label: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS), LLC
connections.note: Bigelow Aerospace gives its own address as 1899 W. Brooks Ave., North Las Vegas, Nevada 89032, and Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies operated from that base. Two caveats keep this at tier 2: the address is North Las Vegas rather than Las Vegas proper, and the company page does not name BAASS, so it fixes the Bigelow location rather than the contracting entity's.

connections.edgeLabel: Reid's Nevada base; earmark performed by a Las Vegas constituent
connections.label: Harry M. Reid
connections.note: This is not merely a home-town link. AARO's official history names 'Senate Majority Leader Harry Reid (D-NV)' as having directed the appropriation, and the federal award record places Bigelow's company in Nevada; the money Reid secured was performed by a company in the state he represented. Tier 2 because the constituent relationship is the inference joining those two documented facts, not something either document states.

connections.label: National Institute for Discovery Science (NIDS)
connections.note: The National Institute for Discovery Science was established in 1995 by Robert T. Bigelow, described in contemporary reporting as a Las Vegas-based millionaire philanthropist and real estate developer, and it investigated both aerial phenomena and the survival of consciousness after death, running a reporting hotline and commissioning veterinary necropsies on animal-mutilation reports. It is the direct institutional predecessor of the BAASS staffing that later executed AAWSAP. Tier 2: the source places Bigelow in Las Vegas rather than stating NIDS's own registered address.

desc: Alias identifier for Las Vegas, Nevada, which entered the corpus in two spellings. The place itself is materially important to this board: it is the headquarters city of Bigelow Aerospace and of Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies, the entity that won the DIA AAWSAP contract in 2008; the home of the National Institute for Discovery Science; the base from which journalist George Knapp reported the Bob Lazar story in 1989; and the nearest metropolitan area to the Nevada Test and Training Range. The merge pass should collapse this into l-las-vegas.
